initial.title: Prepare a bicycle service
initial.subtitle: Choose the work to request, review the handover notes, and send the draft to the workshop.
initial.notice: Estimates describe workshop time, not a fixed collection promise.
initial.footer: Sending a service draft requests a mechanic review. No payment or repair authorisation is created by this component.
initial.guidance: Remove loose luggage before handover. The mechanic will confirm parts and labour after inspection. Bring the key for any wheel locks and note noises that occur only under load.
